headline: Computational Legal Studies Workshop 2025 (CLS 2025)
content: Our lab presented a paper at CLS 2025

headline: Environmental Law & Governance Seminar
content: Our lab hosted the Miin Wu School Seminar on Environmental Law and Sustainability Governance, featuring a keynote lecture by Prof. Jiunn-Rong Yeh, with Prof. Hsiao-Wen Wang serving as the discussant and Prof. Shao-Man Lee as the moderator.

headline: International Conference on Emerging Infectious Diseases 2025 (ICEID 2025)
content: Our lab presented a poster at ICEID 2025.

headline: ICON•S TAIWAN CHAPTER 2025 ANNUAL CONFERENCE
content: Our lab faculty member Prof. Shao-Man Lee served as one of the organizers of the ICON•S Taiwan Chapter 2025 Annual Conference.

headline: New Challenges to AI and Copyright
content: Our lab faculty member, Prof. Shao-Man Lee, has invited Prof. Tzu-I Lee, Assistant Professor at the Graduate Institute of Patent, National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST), to deliver a talk.

headline: Book of the Year Prize 2025 — International Forum on the Future of Constitutionalism
content: The book "Judicial Bricolage: The Use of Foreign Precedents by Constitutional Judges in the 21st Century" (Hart Publishing, eds. Tania Groppi, Marie-Claire Ponthoreau, and Irene Spigno), in which Prof. Shao-Man Lee co-authored Chapter 13 with Prof. Wen-Chen Chang, has been awarded the Book of the Year Prize 2025 by the International Forum on the Future of Constitutionalism.
